create_EvaluationModuleInfo: create an EvaluationModuleInfo dataclass with description, citation, and features for a metric
create_MetricInfo: create a MetricInfo dataclass that extends EvaluationModuleInfo with module_type set to metric
create_ComparisonInfo: create a ComparisonInfo dataclass that extends EvaluationModuleInfo with module_type set to comparison
create_MeasurementInfo: create a MeasurementInfo dataclass that extends EvaluationModuleInfo with module_type set to measurement
build_EvaluationModuleInfo_from_director: build an EvaluationModuleInfo instance from a JSON file in a given directory
build_EvaluationModuleInfo_from_dict: build an EvaluationModuleInfo instance from a dictionary of metric info fields
run_EvaluationModuleInfo_write_to_direct: run write_to_directory to save EvaluationModuleInfo as JSON and license to a directory
